youtube.metaTitle: Feel&Note Video Archive | Library Tour & Faction Atlas
youtube.metaDescription: Explore Feel&Note original video series Library Tour and Faction Atlas, with full-episode and short-form playlists in one place.
youtube.title: The world of remarkable figures, unfolded on film
youtube.intro: Begin with one person's library, then step back to see the forces that moved an age. Discover two ways Feel&Note records cultural lives and human alliances.
youtube.seriesIntro: Library Tour reads the inner life; Faction Atlas maps the relationships between lives.
youtube.koreanPlaylist: Faction Atlas is currently available on the Korean-language channel.

library.title: Library Tour
library.tagline: A person’s library is a map of the life they travelled.
library.description: Follow the books historical figures actually read or recommended. Each episode traces how a book entered a life and left its mark on decisions, ideas, and achievements.
library.imageAlt: A dark circular screening library lined with bookshelves, statues, and a film projector

faction.title: Faction Atlas
faction.tagline: The same question can divide remarkable people into opposing circles.
faction.description: Figures across eras and fields are arranged around one defining problem. Read the alliances, collisions, and individual voices as a single living composition.
faction.imageAlt: A dark council chamber with a monumental relief map and empty seats arranged around it

youtube.archiveDescription: Play the full episodes and one-book shorts connected to figures in the Feel&Note archive.
youtube.factionArchiveDescription: Videos from the public Faction Atlas playlists. Published entries also show their connected faction names.
youtube.factionLongformSub: Full-length maps of the groups and clashes around one question
youtube.factionShortsSub: A defining alliance or conflict, compressed into one short video
youtube.longformSub: Full-length tours through one figure's entire library
youtube.shortsSub: Short videos on the story of a figure and a single book
